name: splice-delta-application
body: The DML half of the splice: `rust.apg.splice.apply.apply` seeds from the previous DB and applies the delta's code tables (Language/Module/Struct/Function/File/UnresolvedTarget plus their rels), with the delete scope bounded by the phase-2 target set and the assembled graph vouching only for units it reaches. It writes no authored/transient row — the eligibility guard must therefore never admit a splice whose authored rows are stale.
